summary: Switch the v1 TUI sidebar directly to the shared projection and widget

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: The TUI now uses the shared v1 projection and widget without a fallback renderer. Complete server-resolved maps are required; unavailable resolution is reported explicitly instead of guessing from raw registers. Existing input, theme and hit routing are retained.

manual.detail: No deployment action or migration required.

recovery.detail: The cutover changes no persisted-state format; reverting requires no state migration.
